issue.title: feat(widgets): add missing & queued media widget for Radarr and Sonarr

repository.name: homarr
repository.description: A modern and easy to use dashboard. 40+ integrations. 20K+ icons built in. Authentication out of the box. No YAML, drag and drop configuration.

issue.body:
## Summary

- Adds a **Media Missing & Queue** widget that shows which movies/episodes are missing from your library and what is currently downloading, pulling data from Radarr and Sonarr
- Poster-art backdrop-blur behind each card for ambient colour (matches the `media-releases` widget pattern); animated striped progress bars + pulse dot for active downloads; hover lift + primary-colour border
- Width-based column scaling — fills wide widgets with multiple columns instead of stretching one column; collapses to count-only tabs at narrow widths
- Default size 4×3 so the widget ships at a useful scale; `addItemToBoard` mutation now reads `widgetDefaultSizes` instead of always using 1×1
- Documentation page with screenshots (missing grid, download queue, compact view)

## Screenshots

| Missing tab (4×3) | Queue tab | Compact (2×1) |
|---|---|---|
| ![missing](https://github.com/xanyl/homarr/raw/feat/missing-queued-widget/apps/docs/docs/widgets/media-missing/img/missing.png) | ![queued](https://github.com/xanyl/homarr/raw/feat/missing-queued-widget/apps/docs/docs/widgets/media-missing/img/queued.png) | ![compact](https://github.com/xanyl/homarr/raw/feat/missing-queued-widget/apps/docs/docs/widgets/media-missing/img/compact.png) |

## Changes

- `packages/widgets/src/media-missing/component.tsx` — full visual redesign with backdrop cards, density system, width-based columns
- `packages/widgets/src/media-missing/component.module.css` — card, backdrop, poster, pulse-dot styles
- `packages/definitions/src/widget.ts` — `mediaMissing` default size 4×3; `widgetDefaultSizes` map
- `packages/definitions/src/docs/widget-doc-slugs.ts` — adds `mediaMissing: "media-missing"` (fixes typecheck)
- `packages/api/src/router/board.ts` — `addItemToBoard` reads `widgetDefaultSizes` instead of hardcoding 1×1
- `apps/docs/docs/widgets/media-missing/` — documentation page + screenshots
- `packages/integrations/.../media-organizer-types.ts` — `year?: number` added to `QueuedMediaItem` (Radarr was already setting it)
- `apps/nextjs/src/components/access/inherit-access-table.tsx` — fix duplicate React key `admin-group-id`

## Test plan

- [ ] Add widget from the widget picker → spawns at 4×3
- [ ] Resize to 1×2 (narrow): tabs collapse to icon + count only, single-column grid
- [ ] Resize to 2×1 (wide+short): two columns, shorter cards
- [ ] Resize to 4×3 (large): three or four columns with backdrop art visible
- [ ] Queue tab: progress bars animate; pulse dot visible for in-progress downloads
- [ ] No console errors on BoardSettingsPage (duplicate key fix)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a new “Media Missing & Queue” widget that shows missing and queued items from supported media integrations.
  * Added widget controls to show/hide missing or queued items and adjust page size.
  * The widget now adapts to different sizes and displays richer item details, progress, and status.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved access list rendering by removing duplicate inherited entries.
  * Newly added widgets now use their intended default size on boards.
